input_encoding.description: Encoding used for reading input files (e.g., utf-8, latin-1).

output_encoding.description: Encoding used for writing output files.

input_locale.description: Locale used for parsing input data (e.g., numbers, dates).

output_locale.description: Locale used for formatting output data.

mode.description: The primary command to execute: convert, join, sort, or sum.

convert_source.description: Source URI or file path for the 'convert' command.

convert_destination.description: Destination URI or file path for the 'convert' command.

join_keys.description: List of column names to join on. Items: key_name (string)

join_sources.description: List of source URIs or file paths to join. Items: source_path (string)

join_destination.description: Destination URI or file path for the 'join' command.

sort_key.description: Column name to sort by for the 'sort' command.

sort_source.description: Source URI or file path for the 'sort' command.

sort_destination.description: Destination URI or file path for the 'sort' command.

sum_sources.description: List of source URIs or file paths to sum. Items: source_path (string)

sum_destination.description: Destination URI or file path for the 'sum' command.
